description: Branch R-SORT-3 Null policy / aliases, DAO property combinations, repairing the earlier ordering defect (which put Unique False after Primary True and so lost the Primary flag): a property is put only when it is True. Six tables X1..X6 (ID, K Long, S Text) without a key each get one DAO index on K by CreateIndex, with Primary, Unique, Required and IgnoreNulls set as: Primary + Unique; Primary alone; Unique + Required; Unique + IgnoreNulls; Required alone; Unique + Required + IgnoreNulls. Then the rows (1,10), (2,10), (3,Null), (4,Null) are inserted one by one with dbFailOnError and a marked Errors read. X7 has a DDL primary key and then gets a DAO Primary index (refused?). Reads each index's flags as stored and the surviving rows. Asks which combinations ACE admits, what each refuses (duplicate, Null) and which flags read back.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
